text: The hardest person to call to Allah was the one he loved most: his own father.
And listen to how gently he spoke. "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear, and does not see, and will not benefit you at all?"
O my father, knowledge has come to me that has not come to you. So follow me, and I will guide you to an even path.
O my father, I fear that a punishment from the Most Merciful will touch you.
Four times he said: O my father. Not once did he raise his voice.
But his father answered: "Have you no desire for my gods, O Ibrahim? If you do not stop, I will surely stone you. So leave me, for a long time."
And Ibrahim said: "Peace be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you from my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me."
